name: AI Safety Team (AIST)
description: A community of Harvard students doing technical and policy research on reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI. Runs nine-week intro fellowships (Technical, Policy, and AI × Biorisk tracks) every semester and summer, meeting weekly in Harvard Square.
join_instructions: Apply to an intro fellowship; membership applications go to fellows after each fellowship. When applications are closed, the interest form on the Join page emails you when the next round opens.
eligibility: Mostly Harvard undergraduate and graduate students and postdocs; some other Boston-area students

legitimacy.run_by_harvard_students: Site describes itself as Harvard students; Berkman Klein Center co-hosted an event series with the group
legitimacy.note: Former names HAIST / AISST; old domain haist.ai fails TLS (certificate does not match), aisst.ai redirects to aisafetyteam.org
